newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador gov't plans fiscal and monetary measures.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador gov't plans fiscal and monetary measures.

text.p: The economic plan to be announced by Ecuador's government in coming days will include fiscal and monetary adjustments, Arturo Gangotena, the administration's Secretary General said late Tuesday.
"There are not just fiscal measures, but they will also maintain stability and credibility in terms of foreign exchange and monetary policy," Gangotena told journalists.

However, Gangotena said the measures will not lead to an "economic shock." Former President Abdala Bucaram, who was recently ousted by Congress, introduced a series of harsh austerity measures to fight the budget deficit.
"The president (Fabian Alarcon) does not believe in harsh measures, despite the existence of a large budget deficit," he said.
Analysts estimate that Ecuador's deficit will rise to between five and seven percent of gross domestic product by the end of 1997.
"The government will announce this week the pertinent economic measures to correct the budgetary problems the country has," said Gangotena.
